definitions.explanation: The opening phase of a time period such as a century, decade, year, or month. Typically attaches to a time word to specify the early portion.

examples.japanese: 20{世紀|せいき}{初頭|しょとう}のことだ。
examples.english: It was at the beginning of the 20th century.

examples.japanese: 2000{年代|ねんだい}{初頭|しょとう}にインターネットが{急速|きゅうそく}に{普及|ふきゅう}した。
examples.english: The internet spread rapidly in the early 2000s.

examples.japanese: {明治|めいじ}{時代|じだい}{初頭|しょとう}に{日本|にほん}は{近代化|きんだいか}への{道|みち}を{歩|あゆ}み{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: At the beginning of the Meiji era, Japan started on the path to modernization.

notes:
{初頭|しょとう} means the beginning or early part of a time period. Composed of {初|しょ} (first, beginning) + {頭|とう} (head). Almost always follows a time-period noun.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {世紀|せいき}{初頭|しょとう}: beginning of a century
- {年代|ねんだい}{初頭|しょとう}: beginning of a decade
- {年|ねん}{初頭|しょとう}: beginning of the year
- 21{世紀|せいき}{初頭|しょとう}: early 21st century
- 2000{年代|ねんだい}{初頭|しょとう}: early 2000s

REGISTER:
Used in written and formal contexts — news, academic writing, history. Rarely used in casual conversation.

TIME PERIOD TERMS:
- {初頭|しょとう}: beginning (formal)
- {中頃|なかごろ}: middle
- {後半|こうはん}: latter half
- {末|まつ}/{末期|まっき}: end

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {冒頭|ぼうとう}: opening, beginning (of a speech, book, etc. — not time periods)
- {当初|とうしょ}: initially, at first
